text: sed -n '236,300p' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fgets.rs: x13, x13, #1"); // advance the line length by 1 byte emitter.instruction("str x13, [sp, #8]"); // store the updated line length // -- check if the byte we just read is \n -- emitter.instruction("cmp w14, #0x0A"); // compare with newline character emitter.instruction("b.eq __rt_fgets_done"); // if newline, line is complete emitter.instruction("b __rt_fgets_loop"); // otherwise continue reading // -- user-wrapper line read: feof-gated stream_read, one byte at a time. // feof is checked BEFORE each read so the loop never makes the EOF read // whose empty result would cross the wrapper-method boundary. Bytes are // appended to _user_wrapper_drain_buf — NOT _concat_buf, because each // __rt_fread result may itself occupy _concat_buf and clobber the line. // [sp,#8] tracks the accumulated line length; the line is returned // directly (this path does not reuse the _concat_buf-based done label).
